info.title: LIVA GPT Actions API
info.description: GPT action schema for real LIVA reads and live writes.

get.description: Compact daily snapshot for coaching decisions. Use this for broad daily check-ins like 'was steht heute an?' or 'LIVA check'. Heart-rate semantics are explicit: nocturnal/sleep pulse values live under heart_rate and must not be described as resting heart rate.
Long-term goals, active plans, constraints and useful context.
Domain freshness and availability for LIVA data. Use this when the user asks whether LIVA is current, stable or missing data.
Read today's cached calendar events and free blocks from the existing calendar sync cache only. Never writes and never calls Google directly.
Read cached calendar events for a date range grouped by day from the existing synced calendar store.
Search cached calendar events by title, description or location within an optional date range.
Read a compact daily context with calendar, recovery, weight and the current training decision status. Use it to see whether a fresh GPT coaching decision already exists or must be regenerated.
Current LIVA CORE decision mode and override state.
Returns the stored CORE Daily Board for a date, creating a Phase-1 fallback board if none exists. Use this only when the user explicitly asks to inspect the CORE Board or its reasoning.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Board date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

get.description: Returns a compact GPT-safe morning context so the daily board payload can stay short and use the correct session label. Always call this first for morning triggers like 'Gewicht & HRV sind drin', 'Check CORE' or 'Morgencheck'.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Morning context date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

get.description: Reads Intervals.icu endurance approval for the day, including original workout, LIVA execution mode and final recommendation.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Approval date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

post.description: Sets the LIVA execution mode for an Intervals.icu endurance workout. Does not write to Intervals.icu.

Persists the GPT/LIVA machine briefing and human decision copy for the day, and can optionally build a persisted CORE Training-Card. Only call this after getCoreMorningContext in the same turn. For morning flows use mode='gpt_fast', memory_mode='skip', build_training_card=true and persist=true.

get.description: Read the persisted CORE Training-Card for the requested day. Use this when the user asks what today's Training-Card looks like or what today's training says.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Training-card date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

post.description: Builds and persists a CORE Training-Card from the stored CORE Board, plan context and safe history fallbacks.

get.description: Returns CORE Memory-Events grouped by today, week, phase, year and global layers.

post.description: Promotes a stored CORE Memory-Event and can optionally apply it to the existing Memory markdown service.
Reads CORE Memory events, consolidations, file patches or a compact review summary through one GPT-friendly endpoint.
Builds deferred memory events, consolidation drafts or file-patch drafts. Use artifact='events' after gpt_fast board builds, not in the critical morning path.
Controls CORE Memory events, consolidations or file patches through one GPT-friendly review endpoint while keeping legacy event payloads compatible.

get.description: Returns draft, applied or dismissed CORE Memory consolidation proposals.

post.description: Builds reviewable consolidation drafts from similar CORE Memory-Events.
Applies, dismisses or updates a CORE Memory consolidation draft.
Applies, dismisses or marks selected CORE Memory consolidation drafts in batch mode.

get.description: Returns reviewable append-only Memory file patch drafts.

post.description: Builds reviewable Memory file patch drafts from stable consolidations.
Applies, dismisses or updates a reviewable Memory file patch.
Writes the active CORE day override.

get.description: Active training plan frame, upcoming days and recent sessions. Use this for a compact training status instead of the full plan structure.

post.description: Filtered training sessions, plan days or recent summaries.
Exercise history with resolved names, best sets and e1RM.

post.summary: Log gym session from raw text
post.description: Logs a gym session from OCR/plain text or structured exercises. Put actual RPE in every individual sets[] object, for example {weight:80,reps:8,rpe:9}; RPE only in free text, notes, or exercise-level fields is not sufficient. If any set rpe is missing, ask before writing when possible; omitted RPE remains null and the result is incomplete with warnings.missing_rpe and incomplete_fields.missing_rpe_count. Never create a duplicate session to correct an existing one. For notebook photos, call dry_run=true first to preview date, session, exercises and sets. Only use dry_run=false after user confirmation, then verify with getTrainingData.

get.description: Returns the full GPT-ready context needed to decide today's planned training session, including plan, recovery, bodyweight, check-in and recent exercise history.

post.description: Validates and stores the concrete GPT coaching decision for today's training session. Replaces the previous active decision for that day with a superseded record.

get.description: Returns the compact dashboard card built from the persisted GPT coaching decision for the requested day.
Returns a coach-facing view of a logged workout with exercise indices, set indices and comparison to the latest comparable session.
Read a compact long-term training deep dive: volume by muscle, progression by exercise, best/weak phases, stagnation risks, coach insights.

post.description: Edits identity, variation or authored notes of a historical logged exercise by workout_id and zero-based exercise_index without changing the active training plan. Successful live writes include canonical_readback; never claim success unless it matches.
Edits a historical logged set by workout_id, exercise_index and set_index without changing the active training plan.

get.description: Active plan with exercises, sets, rep targets and RPE targets. Use this for week-plan or plan-structure questions; keep detail='compact' unless the user explicitly wants the full structure.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Use compact for GPT-friendly day labels and exercise display names; full returns event and exercise objects.

get.description: Lists training plans with compact counts and totals. Use detail endpoints before patching.
Always call this detail-read before patching a training plan. Returns full days, workouts, exercises and set targets.
Always call this detail-read before patching a training plan. Returns full days, workouts, exercises and set targets for one plan_id.
Search real exercises from movement_library so GPT can resolve exercise_id and canonical_id safely.
Read one exercise from movement_library with canonical_id, equipment and notes.

post.description: Patch a training plan with top-level dry_run and operations. This endpoint performs live writes when dry_run=false. Always call detail-read before patching a plan. Use exercise_path/set_path for targeted training changes. Training writes persist to the real training plan source.
Progression series for GPT analysis.

get.description: Coach-facing progression summary with grouped trends, key lifts and next targets.
Coach-facing progression summary for one canonical exercise.

post.description: Compares exercises across two date ranges.

get.description: Recovery summary from HRV and annotations. Use this for direct questions about recovery, HRV, sleep or readiness. night_pulse_bpm is a nocturnal/sleep pulse value and must not be described as resting heart rate; resting_heart_rate_bpm stays null unless a true resting-heart-rate source is available.

post.description: Filtered HRV/recovery rows. Use this when the user wants recovery history or trend analysis.
Writes recovery flags or day annotations. Only use this when the user explicitly asks to record a sickness, alcohol, fatigue or recovery flag.
Creates a read-only guest key with a capped lifetime. Never grants write access.

get.description: Nutrition targets, today actuals and adherence state.
Compact nutrition timing for meal hours, concrete foods and carb/protein timing around training.
Search the nutrition food database for concrete food suggestions and replacements.
Search concrete foods with ids and macros per 100g so GPT can resolve food_id safely.
List real meal templates from the nutrition template library.
Read one nutrition meal template with concrete template items.
Lists nutrition plans with is_active, status, archived, deleted and compact counts/totals. Use detail endpoints before patching.
Always call this detail-read before patching a nutrition plan. Returns full days, meals and slots. Slots are addressed primarily by slot_path, not slot_id.

Always call this detail-read before patching a nutrition plan. Returns full days, meals and slots for one plan_id. slot_path is the preferred stable slot address; slot_id may be null when no unique item id exists.

post.description: Patch a nutrition plan with top-level dry_run and operations. This endpoint performs live writes when dry_run=false. Always call detail-read before patching a plan. Use slot_path for targeted nutrition slot changes. Nutrition writes persist to nutrition_slot_meal_items and nutrition_slot_meals, not overrides.
Logged meals, planned meals, targets and remaining macros.
Logs exactly one existing planned meal from its stored planned items. Use this for requests like 'Frühstück loggen' or 'Meal 1 fertig' after reading planned meals; it does not invent free-form foods.
Writes targets, planned meals, free meals or meal edits.

get.description: Compact cut/bulk status with weight trend, nutrition adherence, training and recovery context.
Returns the current bodyweight phase report when phase metadata is available.

post.description: Stores minimal bodyweight phase metadata so the phase report can read the current cut, bulk or maintenance phase.

get.description: Latest weight, trend and check-in status. Use this for current weight and trend questions.

post.description: Filtered weight logs. Use this for weight history, trend, maintenance, cut or bulk analysis.
Writes, edits or deletes canonical weight logs. Only use this when the user explicitly provides a weight value to record; 'Gewicht ist drin' should stay a read flow.

get.description: Run state and recent run summary. Use this for compact cardio, run, ergo or Z2 status.
Compact run and ergo summary with separated rollups, latest sessions and conservative Z2 estimates.

post.description: Filtered run sessions. Use this for cardio history, Z2, ergo or run-data analysis.
Creates or deletes canonical cardio sessions. Only use this when the user explicitly provides cardio data to log; do not invent values.

get.description: Concrete planned exercises plus recent history and rounded load suggestions for explicit training/progression questions.
Calendar, school-day load, free windows and whether planned training fits the day.
Compact subjective day-form payload. Gracefully reports available=false when no morning check-in exists.
External Intervals.icu week context; sessions are explicitly marked external and are not part of a LIVA Endurance plan.
Memory service status and metadata.

post.description: Reads Memory files, context and filtered entries.

Writes targeted Memory content. When the usememos backend is active, GPT should actively read useful prior memory, store only relevant long-lived or situationally important facts, and may modify or delete only memos whose content begins with #gpt. User memos without #gpt stay read-only.
Executes an allowlisted device, scene or PC action.
Normalizes raw OCR/GPT gym exercise names and variants using the active plan, historical names and weight-based variant matching. Call this before saving screenshot-based gym logs.

get.description: Known exercise names and variants from active plan and history. Useful before OCR/GPT gym import.

dry_run.description: Use dry_run=true first unless the user explicitly requests live write.

operations.description: Top-level ordered patch operations. Always call detail-read before patching a plan. For nutrition slots, prefer match.slot_path over slot_id. Supports delete_empty_meals and delete_meal.

HeartRateSemanticInfo.description: Semantic heart-rate payload for GPT actions. night_pulse_bpm is a nocturnal/sleep pulse value and must not be described as resting heart rate. resting_heart_rate_bpm is null unless a true resting-heart-rate source is available.

mode.description: Use gpt_fast for morning check-ins when GPT only needs a compact confirmation response.

memory_mode.description: For gpt_fast, defaults to 'skip' so memory building does not block the response. Use 'sync' to force the legacy synchronous memory build.

debug_timing.description: Include compact timing measurements in the response.

source_message.description: The athlete's raw check-in sentence or GPT-visible prompt context.

training_card.description: Optional GPT-authored training-card hints that get stored on the CORE Board and can seed the persisted CORE Training-Card. May include title, summary, items and today_changed_lines.

today_changed_lines.description: Short, concrete day-specific change lines written by GPT for the visible CORE-Prognose. Use this instead of generic mode text whenever concrete signals exist.

source_message.description: Optional user text hint such as 'logge Frühstück'.

raw_text.description: OCR/plain text for training log import.

meal.description: For nutrition/control log_planned_meal: Meal number or label, e.g. 1 or Meal 1.

meal_number.description: For nutrition/control log_planned_meal: 1-based planned meal number.

substitutions.description: For log_planned_meal: replacements like old_food Apfel to new_food Apfelmus, amount 60, unit g.

all_planned.description: For nutrition/control log_planned_meal: log all open planned meals for the date.

override_items.description: For log_planned_meal only: false by default. Planned meal items are used unless this is explicitly true.

append_items.description: For edit_logged_meal: append provided items to the existing meal instead of replacing all items.

add.description: Alias item array for edit_logged_meal append.

append.description: Alias item array for edit_logged_meal append.

stair_floors.description: For Stair Master: climbed floors/Etagen. Used instead of distance entry when available.

sport_type.description: Cardio import: use run for Laufen, ergo for Ergometer/indoor bike, and stair for Stair Master.

sport.description: Alias for sport_type. Accepts Laufen/run, Ergo/ergometer or Stair Master/stair.

duration.description: Cardio duration. Prefer HH:MM:SS or MM:SS, e.g. 31:40 or 01:23:00.

duration_text.description: Alias for duration. Prefer HH:MM:SS or MM:SS.

pace.description: Run pace as sec/km, min/km number, or MM:SS string.

avg_power.description: Ergo or Stair Master average watts.

avg_power_w.description: Ergo or Stair Master average watts.

cadence_avg.description: Optional Ergo cadence/rpm. Stored only if supported by downstream endpoint.

session_name.description: Workout/session name, e.g. Push or Pull.

raw_text.description: Raw line-preserving OCR/plain text. Do not normalize sets; LIVA parses forms like Flys: 1. 9x72,8 2. 9x65,8.

dry_run.description: Use true first for GPT preview flows. Only use false after the user confirms the parsed session.

source_message.description: Optional user hint such as 'Foto vom Notizbuch loggen'.

pace.description: Run pace as sec/km, min/km number, or MM:SS string.

avg_power.description: Ergo or Stair Master average watts.

avg_power_w.description: Ergo or Stair Master average watts.

cadence_avg.description: Optional Ergo cadence/rpm. Stored only if supported by downstream endpoint.

dry_run.description: Must be false for this GPT action schema; remote calls exposed here are live requests.

device.description: Friendly names allowed: Licht=desk_strip, Tisch/Schreibtischlampe=schreibtischlampe, linker Monitor=monitor_links, rechter Monitor=monitor_rechts, Monitore=both, Ventilator=ventilator. Use pc_action for PC.

rpe.description: Actual RPE for this set. Send it per set when known; if omitted, the set is stored with rpe=null and the write response reports missing_rpe/incomplete_fields.

progression_excluded.description: Exclude only this set from the current progression quote/comparison.

progression_exclusion_reason.description: Required when progression_excluded=true, e.g. Technik geändert or anderer Seilzug.

variation_user_locked.description: True only when the athlete explicitly confirmed the variant. Otherwise false so LIVA can resolve it from plan and weight history.

progression_excluded.description: Exclude every set of this exercise from the current progression quote/comparison.

progression_exclusion_reason.description: Required when the exercise is excluded; inherited by all its sets.

session_name.description: Current gym session, e.g. Push, Pull, Lower A.

exercises.description: Raw OCR/GPT extracted exercises. Do not pre-standardize names; LIVA resolves names and variants.

sport_type.description: Use run for Laufen/Joggen. Use ergo for Ergometer/indoor bike/Watt/Kadenz screenshots.

started_at.description: Optional ISO datetime; date is enough.

duration.description: Prefer HH:MM:SS or MM:SS, e.g. 31:40 or 01:23:00.

duration_min.description: Alias if only decimal minutes are known.

distance_km.description: Optional. If omitted: run distance can be computed from pace; ergo distance can be estimated from duration and avg_power_w.

pace.description: For run only. MM:SS per km, decimal min/km, or seconds/km.

notes.description: Authored exercise note. Send an empty string to clear it; automatic progression-exclusion context remains visible in canonical readback.

food_name.description: Food name to resolve, e.g. Hähnchenbrust.

unit.description: Unit such as g, ml, pcs or kcal.
